message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (1–9, two of each 0–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Wild”, two “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may either:
1. **Play** one or more cards that match the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately. | | **Card Types** | - **Number cards** (0–9): play if same color or same number.
- **Draw Two**: next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
- **Skip**: next player loses a turn.
- **Reverse**: changes play direction.
- **Wild**: you declare the next color.
- **Wild Draw Four**: you declare the next color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Playing Multiple Cards** | You may play multiple cards of the same number or color in one turn (e.g., two “5”s of different colors). You can also play a “Wild” followed by a “Wild Draw Four” in the same turn if you have no other playable cards. | | **UNO Call** | When you have exactly one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards: face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
Winner gets those points. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – knowing what’s coming helps you plan your moves. 2. **Use “Wild” cards strategically** – change the color to suit your hand or force opponents into a tough spot. 3. **Challenge wisely** – if you suspect a “Wild Draw Four” was played illegally, you can challenge. If you’re right, the offending player draws four cards; if wrong, you draw six. 4. **Manage your hand size** – try to keep a mix of colors and numbers so you always have options. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
